premises.text: Text-only or voice-only messaging each fails in contexts where the other format is needed
premises.evidence_span: Voice applications are great if you're in the car driving, but if you're in a meeting or in class, they're basically unusable

premises.text: Talks puts text and voice in every message so users need not choose format
premises.evidence_span: Talks incorporates text and voice into every message

premises.text: The app supports rich social posting and media types including pictures, video, doodles, music, and location
premises.evidence_span: supports pictures, voice, video, doodles, music, and location

premises.text: Multi-platform launch and no requirement that receivers have the app drive virality
premises.evidence_span: talks doesn't require the receiver to have the app so I can send messages literally to anyone

premises.text: Voice cloning learns the sender's voice so messages and social posts can be read aloud in that voice
premises.evidence_span: Over time, it learns your voice when you speak to the app, and it creates a voice clone of you on the cloud

value.text: People communicate without choosing between text and voice across contexts
value.evidence_span: you won't have to choose whether you type or talk or read or listen
